wmdr:Description.wmdr:description: The Kennaook / Cape Grim Baseline Air Pollution Station is located on a cliff-top (approximate elevation 90 m a.s.l.) near the northern end of the west coast of Tasmania, overlooking the Southern Ocean. The building is on a small block surrounded by a 25 ha buffer zone. A small area within and adjacent to the building is leased to a telecommunications company, whose 80 m tower is used by the station. The buffer zone is surrounded by 22,000 ha of regional land used for beef, dairy and wind farming. From the station, the baseline sector is 190-280 degrees. Winds from this sector occur about 35 % of the time. The station is supported by an office in Smithton and laboratories at Aspendale, Victoria. Station specifications, site plan, and program summaries are given in the station's annual report (Baseline), available on request.
